_comment: Self-referential regression vector generated from this repo's own implementation. NOT external/independent vectors, NOT an audit. Detects drift, not correctness. Unaudited; coin has no value.
description: Deterministic keygen-from-seed for the ML-DSA-65 || Falcon-1024 hybrid signer (bloch::crypto).
notes: ML-DSA halves are platform-stable and pinned. Falcon half is NOT byte-pinned (fp/platform caveat). The ML-DSA signature digest is from a REGRESSION-ONLY seeded-deterministic path; production signing is hedged/randomized.
